description: Read OpenVibe.Actor's resource index (ADR-048, plan T13 step 8 phase 2): GET /api/v1/resources lists Actor's tasks as a page of common.resource-summary@1 (common.resource-list-result@1), and GET /api/v1/resources/:ovrn reads one by its OVRN (common.resource-summary@1). Kind actor.task, id tsk_<ULID>, named by the start of the task text, state the task's state, owner the requesting person when the requester is a user subject. A task asked under a project carries that project_id and so an OVRN; the rest have neither. Planned until Actor serves the index.
